sections.content: How many people are "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport"?

15,040 people

were counted on the census as "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Directors in logistics, warehousing and transport plan, organise, direct and co-ordinate the activities and resources necessary for the safe, efficient and economic movement of passengers and freight by road, rail, sea and air transport, and the receipt, storage and warehousing of goods and the maintenance of stocks at an optimal level.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" there were more men than women (82.7% compared with 17.3%).

This means "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "corporate managers and directors".

Men made up 82.7% and women made up 17.3% of "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" included:

  • information technology directors
  • cyber security professionals
  • waste disposal and environmental services managers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport", 17.1% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport" included:

  • chief executives and senior officials
  • production managers and directors in manufacturing
  • early education and childcare services proprietors

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "directors in logistics, warehousing and transport", 6.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (80.5% compared with 19.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (63.8%) than self-employed (36.2%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included West Northamptonshire, this is in the region of the East Midlands.
